problem_text: Find the number of positive integer palindromes written in base 10, with no zero digits, and whose digits add up to 13. Recall that a palindrome is a number whose representation reads the same from left to right as from right to left.
notes: Only odd-digit palindromes are possible (sum 13 odd). For each odd center digit c in {1,3,5,7,9}: 2^((13-c)/2-1) palindromes; plus 1 for c=13 (invalid, digit>9) and 1 for c=11 (invalid). Total = 64 - 2 = 62. Brute-force confirmed up to 15-digit palindromes.
